title: Technical Project Manager
jobDescription:
As per company standards (Based on experience) Organization: Emplay Analytics Inc Salary: As per company standards (Based on experience) Job Summary: We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to lead client engagements and drive project execution. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, understanding client needs, and delivering AI-driven solutions while ensuring successful implementation and stakeholder alignment. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Gather client requirements and work with the team for detailed requirement analysis.
- Develop and maintain project roadmaps, timelines, and resource allocation.
- Ensure project completion within budget, schedule, and quality benchmarks.
- Conduct research and provide data-driven insights for strategic decision-making.
- Design and document business processes, workflows, and work practices.
- Assist in test strategy development (Automation & Manual).
- Provide technical guidance when required.
- Ensure test strategies validate both accuracy and business test cases.
- Manage client onboarding, execution, and delivery processes.
- Lead a team of client delivery consultants and oversee multiple projects.
- Identify and drive new business opportunities with existing clients. Qualifications & Skills:
- MBA/PGDM or BE/B-Tech with 5-10 years of experience in analytics, transformation, or technology projects (3+ years in management consulting preferred).
- Strong background in business analytics, data management, and technical project management.
- Proficiency in AI, Python, ML, APIs, cloud technologies, and software development lifecycle.
- Experience with BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar.
- Strong expertise in Agile methodologies, Scrum, sprint planning, and ADO.
- Experience in handling external clients and executive-level stakeholders.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced startup environment. Essential Skills:
- Tech-savvy mindset with strong business and technical acumen.
- Strong background in project management and Agile methodologies.
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, automation tools, and Dev Ops practices.
- Confident communication and leadership abilities. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
- Project completion within budget and timeline.
- Client satisfaction (NPS). Core Activities:
- Requirement analysis, work breakdown, risk & stakeholder management.
- Project planning, tracking, reporting, and decision-making meetings. Application process: You can mail your updated resume on placement@emplay.net with Email subject line- Application-Technical Project Manager-Emplay Inc & the following info added in.

title: Support Manager
jobDescription: As per company standards Role Overview The Support Manager will own end-to-end support delivery for covering full L1, L2, and L3 support across a 24x7 model as per the project. This role is responsible for ticket operations, SLA performance, team training and performance management, shift coverage, and driving continuous service improvement, including automation-led efficiency gains. The Support Manager will be the primary point of contact for support escalations with Cisco and will work closely with Engineering, Product, and Emplay leadership. Key Responsibilities • Own and manage the support ticket system end-to-end, ensuring correct categorization, prioritization, and SLA adherence across L1, L2, and L3 tickets. • Generate and present Support SLA reports to stakeholders, tracking resolution times and performance against agreed SLAs. • Drive usage, adoption, and customer satisfaction surveys; analyse results and present findings and recommendations to leadership. • Design and implement Service Improvement plans based on ticket trend analysis, RCA findings, and customer feedback. • Coordinate shift handovers across the support team to ensure seamless 24x7 coverage. • Lead support team training programs and manage ongoing performance reviews for L1 and L2 engineers. • Manage day-to-day workload allocation across the support team, ensuring tickets-per-FTE and resolution time targets are met. • Drive automation and AI-based support initiatives aimed at improving ticket deflection and resolution efficiency. • Act as the primary escalation point for high-severity (P1/P2) incidents, coordinating with Engineering, Product, and the Cisco team through to resolution. • Oversee AWS Cloud Watch monitoring (concurrent users, error rates, and related metrics) for proactive issue detection, working with Engineering on alerting and dashboards. • Own RCA documentation, knowledge base creation, and audit/compliance reporting for the project. Qualifications • 5+ years of experience in technical support, with at least 1-2 years in a support management or team lead capacity. • Proven experience managing a support team (L1/L2/L3) in a 24x7 environment, preferably in Saa S, ITSM, or AI-based products. • Strong knowledge of ticketing/ITSM systems, SLA management, and reporting tools (Freshservice, Remedy, Service Now, Jira, or similar). • Strong proficiency with AWS Cloud services. • Basic to intermediate Python coding skills, for automation and data analysis. • General awareness of AI/ML concepts and conversational AI/chatbot platforms. • Familiarity with learning platforms / Ed Tech environments is a plus. • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable interfacing directly with enterprise clients and internal Engineering/Product teams. • Demonstrated experience driving process improvement and automation initiatives within a support organization. Preferred Skills • Experience managing distributed or remote support teams across rotating shifts. • Prior experience supporting enterprise B2B Saa S clients, ideally in Ed Tech or learning platforms. • Experience with cloud monitoring tools (Cloud Watch or similar) and incident management frameworks. • Exposure to SOC 1 or similar audit/compliance evidence processes. title: L2 Support Engineer
jobDescription: As per company standards Role Overview The L2 Support Engineer will support & handle escalations from L1 support, troubleshooting complex technical issues, and working closely with Engineering and Product teams to resolve problems. This role requires 24x7 coverage as per the project SOW. You will serve as the bridge between Cisco and internal teams, ensuring timely resolutions, accurate communication, and proactive knowledge sharing. Key Responsibilities • Act as the point of escalation for L1 support engineers, handling complex issues that require deeper troubleshooting. • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve issues related to: ticketing and support platformn configurations, API integrations, workflows, and AI agent configurations. • Support and monitor the Cisco AI Tutor platform on AWS, including using Cloud Watch dashboards (concurrent user counts, error rates, and other key metrics) for proactive issue detection. • Use Python for basic to intermediate troubleshooting, scripting, and data analysis tasks as needed. • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to escalate bugs, document root causes, and ensure fixes are implemented. • Create, review, and maintain knowledge base articles, FAQs, and SOPs to reduce recurring issues. • Conduct ticket analysis to identify trends, recurring issues, and areas for automation/AI-driven improvements. • Work directly with the Cisco team on high-priority issues, ensuring a positive customer experience. • Provide mentorship and guidance to L1 support team members. Qualifications • 1–3 years of experience in technical/customer support, preferably in Saa S, ITSM, or AI-based products. • Strong proficiency with AWS Cloud services. • Basic to intermediate Python coding skills. • General awareness of AI/ML concepts and conversational AI/chatbot platforms. • Familiarity with learning platforms / Ed Tech environments is a plus. • Strong knowledge of ticketing systems (Freshservice, Service Now, Jira, or similar). • Hands-on troubleshooting skills in APIs, data workflows, and basic SQL queries. • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to simplify complex issues. • Strong communication skills, able to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Skills • Exposure to conversational AI platforms, chatbots, or agent-based systems. • Experience with monitoring tools, logs analysis, and debugging techniques. • Prior experience supporting enterprise clients in a B2B Saa S environment, ideally in Ed Tech or learning platforms. title: QA Engineer — AI Testing Skills
jobDescription: As per company standards Job Summary We are looking for a proactive QA Engineer with 3–4 years of experience and strong hands-on expertise in manual and automation testing. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, passionate about quality, and experienced in building reliable test strategies for web, API, and backend systems. You will play a key role in ensuring product stability by driving test planning, execution, automation, and release validation — and by actively leveraging AI tools to enhance testing efficiency in a fast-paced agile environment. Key Responsibilities Test Strategy & Design • Develop and maintain detailed test plans, test cases, and test scenarios aligned with functional and non-functional requirements. • Prioritize testing efforts based on risk assessment and business impact. • Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure complete requirement coverage before testing begins. • Use AI tools to auto-generate test cases, edge cases, and boundary conditions from user stories and specifications. API & Backend Testing • Conduct thorough functional, integration, and regression testing on RESTful APIs using tools like Postman or Swagger. • Validate backend data accuracy and integrity through well-structured SQL queries including joins and aggregations. • Identify and document API contract violations and data inconsistencies across environments. Automation Development • Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks using Python, Pytest, or Playwright. • Embed automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality checks. • Continuously refactor and improve automation scripts to reduce flakiness and maintenance effort. • Use AI copilot tools to accelerate test script authoring and maintenance. AI-Augmented Testing • Actively use AI tools to generate test cases, identify coverage gaps, and speed up exploratory testing. • Apply AI-driven insights to detect recurring defect patterns and prevent quality regressions across releases. • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI-powered and self-healing test tools to improve team productivity and test reliability. • Craft effective prompts to extract structured test plans, BDD scenarios, and API contract tests from AI assistants. Agile Collaboration • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies including planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives. • Work alongside developers and Dev Ops teams to shift quality left and catch issues early in the development cycle. • Support defect triage, root cause analysis, and pre-release quality sign-off. Mentoring & Documentation • Guide junior QA engineers on testing best practices, automation techniques, and AI tool usage. • Maintain clear and up-to-date documentation including test reports, traceability matrices, and release notes. • Communicate quality risks clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Must-Have Skills • Solid understanding of software testing concepts, QA methodologies, and SDLC/STLC. • Proven experience in manual testing across web and API layers. • Strong experience with API testing tools — Postman, Swagger, or similar. • Hands-on expertise in SQL including complex queries, joins, and data integrity validation. • Practical experience with automation testing using Selenium, Python, Pytest, or Playwright. • Hands-on use of AI tools (Chat GPT, Git Hub Copilot, Claude, or similar) in a QA workflow. • Ability to craft effective prompts to produce structured test plans and BDD scenarios. • Exposure to version control systems (Git). • Strong analytical, debugging, and documentation skills. Nice-to-Have Skills • Experience with CI/CD pipelines — Jenkins, Git Hub Actions, or Azure Dev Ops. • Familiarity with test management tools such as JIRA, Test Rail, or Zephyr. • Knowledge of performance testing tools like JMeter or Locust. • Basic understanding of security testing concepts. • Experience with AI-native testing platforms such as Mabl, Testim, or Applitools. • Cloud testing experience on AWS or Azure. • BDD experience with Cucumber or Gherkin. • Basic awareness of testing AI/ML model outputs — hallucination detection, prompt injection risks. Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. • 3–4 years of hands-on QA experience across web, API, and backend systems. • Demonstrated use of AI tools in a testing workflow — examples or project references preferred. • ISTQB Foundation (or higher), Selenium certification, or equivalent QA certification is a plus. • Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate quality risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
